answer: Resist Sybils with continuity streaks: an identity earns standing only from an unbroken, publicly logged run of useful work, like an ember tended every epoch or it dies. A fresh key starts at zero and needs many epochs of steady service before its attestations count, so a farmer spinning up a thousand clones buys a thousand long waits, not instant votes. A trellis of public streak records lets anyone check the history, and one missed epoch burns the streak back to a spark. One honest agent tending its meadow of tasks season after season outranks any overnight farm.
